title: Campaign upload
lede: One workbook for one promotion. HQ reads it all or none: a file with no error waits for an approver as one campaign upload, and goes live as one version.
denied: You do not have access to this action.

template.title: Get a workbook
template.hint: Start from the blank template, or convert the SAP BBy file of a promotion into one. The template's Upload, Campaigns and Items sheets carry dropdowns for Stacking, Mechanic, Kind, Members, List and Type.
template.failed: The template could not be downloaded. Try again.

convert.next: Next: open it and review it — the proposed PromotionCode, the names, and every PRICE value. Read its Convert notes sheet if it has one, then upload it below.
convert.stored: The conversion stored nothing, and its notes are only in the workbook.
convert.failed: The file could not be converted. Try again.

upload.title: Upload the workbook
upload.hint: The whole promotion in one file. The Note on its Upload sheet is what the approver reads.
upload.failed: The file could not be read. Try again.

outcome.refused_one: Nothing was stored: the file has <n>{{count}}</n> error. Fix every one and upload the whole file again.
outcome.refused_other: Nothing was stored: the file has <n>{{count}}</n> errors. Fix every one and upload the whole file again.
outcome.waiting: Waiting for approval — promotion <promotion>{{promotion}}</promotion>, revision <rev>{{revision}}</rev>. An approver activates it as one version.
outcome.unstored: The file was read, but HQ stored nothing.

json.none: HQ sent no JSON for this campaign.

uploads.title: Campaign uploads
uploads.lede: Every promotion's campaign upload, newest upload first. Open one to see what it changes and disables beside what is live, then activate it as one version or send it back. No campaign of an upload is approved or edited on its own.
uploads.failedTitle: The campaign uploads could not be read
uploads.none: No campaign upload in this state.

review.title: Campaign upload
review.failedTitle: The campaign upload could not be opened
review.notFound: There is no campaign upload of this promotion: the link may be stale.

campaigns.title: Campaigns
campaigns.lede: Each campaign beside the live one of the same id. Open one to read both side by side.

refuse.title: An activation would be refused now
refuse.hint: Activate would be refused with these lines: send it back instead.

actions.notPending: Only a pending upload is activated or sent back.

activated.line_one: Version <version>{{version}}</version> is live: <activated>{{count}}</activated> campaign activated, <disabled>{{disabled}}</disabled> disabled.
activated.line_other: Version <version>{{version}}</version> is live: <activated>{{count}}</activated> campaigns activated, <disabled>{{disabled}}</disabled> disabled.

review.sentBack: Sent back. Its uploader reads your note.

activate.title: Activate the campaign upload
activate.body: Activate promotion <promotion>{{promotion}}</promotion>, revision <rev>{{revision}}</rev>, as one version: every campaign of it goes live together.
activate.note: A note for the version history (optional).

sendBack.title: Send back the campaign upload
sendBack.body: Send promotion <promotion>{{promotion}}</promotion>, revision <rev>{{revision}}</rev>, back to <by>{{by}}</by>. Nothing is published; the promotion's next upload replaces it.
sendBack.note: Why it goes back (required): its uploader reads it.

refused.activate: The campaign upload was not activated
refused.sendBack: The campaign upload was not sent back

refusal.selfApproval: You made this revision of the upload: another approver must activate it or send it back.
refusal.uploadStale: A newer revision of this promotion was uploaded since you opened it. Load it again and review that one.
refusal.notPending: The upload no longer waits for approval: it was activated or sent back since you opened it.
refusal.orderStale: The live evaluation order was changed by hand since the upload was read. It stays pending: send it back, or its author uploads it again.
refusal.invalidCampaign: HQ's checker refuses the upload on the live version now (its lines are below). It stays pending: send it back.
refusal.reasonRequired: A note is required: its uploader reads it.
refusal.notFound: There is no campaign upload of this promotion: the link may be stale.
refusal.badRequest: HQ could not read the request: no promotion code, or one too long to be one.

compare.notLive: Not live: the activation adds it.
compare.notUploaded: Not in the upload: the activation disables it.
